inference_log_left_right.json.source: Earlier replay log, window-level split (superseded by trial-level results)
caveats: The accuracy matches the v7 flagship exports reported in the paper (Table II, 81.4% and 86.4% per-window, window-level split); the file itself does not record subject or architecture.
A window-level split lets overlapping windows of one trial fall on both sides of the split, so this accuracy is optimistic (paper Section 7, Table IV).
The time axis is replay time (125 ms per record), not recording time: the windows are not in recording order.
